metadata.remarks:
Identity Logging and Audit defines the capability to generate, protect, retain, and analyze records of identity-related actions to support accountability, incident investigation, compliance, and non-repudiation. Logging applies across authentication, authorization, lifecycle events, and cross-system traceability.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for roles and responsibilities, SSPPs, standards, procedures, guidelines, and assurance activities related to identity logging and audit. Controls are intentionally scoped to logging sub-capabilities.

components.title: Authentication Logging
components.description: Recording of authentication attempts, outcomes, and contextual attributes.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Log authentication events, including successful and failed attempts.
Ensure authentication audit records contain sufficient detail.

components.title: Authorization Logging
components.description: Recording of authorization decisions and access enforcement outcomes.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Log authorization decisions and access attempts.
Ensure enforcement of authorized access is auditable.

components.title: Lifecycle Event Logging
components.description: Recording of identity lifecycle events such as creation, modification, suspension, and removal.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Log account creation, modification, and removal events.
Provide centralized generation and management of identity-related audit records.

components.title: Traceability
components.description: Correlation and preservation of identity-related records across systems to support investigation and non-repudiation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Provide audit reduction, search, and reporting to support traceability.
Ensure retention of audit records to support investigations.
